title: Article Batch Orchestrator
purpose: Expose one deterministic article:batch entrypoint that consumes APS-2 ARTICLE_READY results and forms a governed, non-authoritative batch plan without re-implementing upstream gate logic.

successorBoundary.APS-4: Candidate orchestration may reuse governed existing candidates or create candidate-only output for selected nodes.
successorBoundary.APS-5: Review batch assembly may bind candidate and existing Human Review/Approval evidence.
successorBoundary.APS-6: Explicit per-node Human decisions remain required before publication.
